code: eq <- transform_mathjax("x = \\frac{-b \\pm \\sqrt{b^2-4ac}}{2a}", to = "mml", display = TRUE) cat(substr(eq, 1, 300)) #>  #> <m:oMath xmlns:m="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/math"> #>   <m:r> #>     <m:t>x=</m:t> #>   </m:r> #>   <m:f> #>     <m:fPr> #>       <m:type m:val="bar"/> #>     </m:fPr> #>     <m:num> #>       <m:r> #>         <m:t>−b±</m:t> #>       </m:r> #>       <m:rad> #>         <m:radPr> #>           <m:degHide m:val="on"/ library(officer)  ns_w <- "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main" ns_m <- "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/math"  # an equation alone in its paragraph alone <- sprintf(   '<w:p xmlns:w="%s"><m:oMathPara xmlns:m="%s">%s</m:oMathPara></w:p>',   ns_w, ns_m, eq ) # an equation in a sentence euler <- transform_mathjax("e^{i\\pi} + 1 = 0", to = "mml") sentence <- sprintf(   '<w:p xmlns:w="%s"><w:r><w:t xml:space="preserve">Euler: </w:t></w:r>%s</w:p>',   ns_w, euler )  doc <- read_docx() doc <- body_add_par(doc, "The quadratic formula:") doc <- body_add_xml(doc, str = alone) doc <- body_add_xml(doc, str = sentence) print(doc, target = tempfile(fileext = ".docx")) eq <- transform_mathjax(   "a^2 + b^2 = c^2",   to = "mml",   rpr = '<w:rPr><w:sz w:val="32"/><w:color w:val="C0392B"/></w:rPr>' )
